Full Complement Cylindrical Roller Bearings

Full Complement Cylindrical Roller Bearings (SL)

A bearing in which the space between the inner and outer rings is completely filled with cylindrical rollers, without a cage.

With a very high radial load capacity, it is used where heavy loads act at low to medium speeds, such as construction machinery, steel mill equipment, material-handling machinery and railway vehicles.
